title: Electronics exchange log
description: Events retain the original elapsed milliseconds. The date anchors the run clock for display. The selected interval is half-open; surrounding points provide context.

list.name: edition
list.label: Recording
list.query:
import "strings"
from(bucket: "synthetic")
  |> range(start: 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z, stop: 2026-01-02T00:00:00Z)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "exchange_event" and r._field == "export_row")
  |> group(columns: ["serial", "edition", "run_id"])
  |> first()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_value: r.serial + " · " + strings.replaceAll(v: r.run_id, t: "-", u: " ") + " · " + strings.substring(v: strings.split(v: r.edition, t: "~")[1], start: 0, end: 8) + "|" + r.edition}))
  |> group()
  |> sort()
list.definition:

panels.title: Requests and replies
panels.description: Large markers identify selected requests and replies. Smaller gray markers are other events in the visible clock range. Vertical position is the original file row; coincident clocks remain distinct.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "synthetic")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "exchange_event" and r.edition =~ /^${edition:regex}$/)
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["elapsed_ms", "export_row"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({"Elapsed ms": r.elapsed_ms, row: r.export_row, position: r.export_row, direction: if r.elapsed_ms >= int(v: "${windowStart}") and r.elapsed_ms < int(v: "${windowStop}") then (if r.kind == "request" then "Selected request" else "Selected reply") else "Surrounding events"}))
  |> duplicate(column: "direction", as: "series")
  |> group(columns: ["series"])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["Elapsed ms", "row"], columnKey: ["direction"], valueColumn: "position")
  |> drop(columns: ["row"])
  |> sort(columns: ["Elapsed ms"])

panels.title: Events in the selection
panels.description: Only events with elapsed time at or after the start and before the end of the selection. Rows are ordered by elapsed time, then file position.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "synthetic")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "exchange_event" and r.edition =~ /^${edition:regex}$/)
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.elapsed_ms >= int(v: "${windowStart}") and r.elapsed_ms < int(v: "${windowStop}"))
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["elapsed_ms", "export_row"])
  |> keep(columns: ["elapsed_ms", "export_row", "event_id", "kind", "correlation", "document", "entry", "source_id", "serial", "revision", "archive_id", "run_id", "edition"])
